12. ESTABLISH – RECTANGULAR RAPID FLASHING BEACON
Monterey Boulevard, eastbound and westbound, at Acadia Street (Supervisor District 7) (Approvable
by the City Traffic Engineer) William Andrews, [staff email removed — see the order]

The Monterey Boulevard Pedestrian Safety Improvement Project proposes to install pedestrian
rectangular rapid flashing beacons at Acadia Street, as well as various pedestrian safety
enhancements throughout the corridor. This project is being funded by the San Francisco County
Transportation Agency's Neighborhood Transportation Program and sponsored by District 7
Supervisor Melgar's office.

Public Comments: Comments in support at public hearing.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
